title: Approval
description: 分镜与终端离线剧本相同：同一轮写出 .tmp/s03/keep.txt，再提议 rm -rf .tmp/s03。默认 on-request：写入放行，危险命令拦住。终端不读你的提示词；这里也不是在跑 code.ts。 / Same storyboard as the terminal offline demo: one turn writes .tmp/s03/keep.txt then proposes rm -rf .tmp/s03. Default on-request allows the write and holds the delete. The script ignores your prompt; this player is not live code.ts.

steps.content: Create a scratch folder and put a note in it
steps.annotation: User sends a task. Offline mode ignores the text and plays a fixed script.

steps.content: turn 1: 2 function_call items in one output — write_file + shell
steps.annotation: Fan-out from s02 still applies. What is new: each call hits classify + the approval gate before dispatch.
Structured write. classify → risk=write. Under on-request, write is not held.
The harness classifies; the model does not self-declare risk.
Allowed calls still go through TOOL_HANDLERS[name], same as s02.
Same turn, second call. classify → risk=danger because of rm -rf.
The gate pauses before dispatch. y runs it; anything else is a denial.
Denial is not a crash: an error function_call_output is fed back and the loop continues.

steps.content: The write landed in .tmp/s03/keep.txt. The rm -rf was held and denied, so the file is still there. Same calls under untrusted would also hold the write; under never both would run.
steps.annotation: No function_call items → loop stops. Same ending as the terminal offline script.
